endorsements.label: Beyond Android MTE: Navigating OEM's Logic Labyrinths
endorsements.description: With some of the first phones with MTE hitting the market, we are once more facing the seemingly imminent doom of our beloved industry. Wait! What about our trusty old friends, the logic bugs? While some turn their attention to weaker SoC components, we're back at Mobile Pwn2Own to show you how a few silly bugs can be chained to effortlessly pwn the latest Samsung and Xiaomi flagships. Read more
